artworks.title: Evening Gathering in the Palais Fries
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 14 × 24 cm (5 1/2 × 9 7/16 in.)
image: 12.4 × 22.4 cm (4 7/8 × 8 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with a group of people gathered around a table. The room is illuminated by a central hanging lamp, casting light over a table where a large sheet of paper is prominently displayed. Around the table, several individuals appear to be engaged in discussion or observation, with some pointing towards the paper. The room is filled with numerous other figures, some standing and conversing in the background. The drawing employs soft shading and fine lines to create a sense of depth and interaction within the space.

artworks.title: Martin Luther
artworks.artist: Daniel Hopfer, after Lucas Cranach the Elder
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man in profile view. He is depicted with prominent facial features, short curly hair on the sides of his head, a large round cap, and a cloak or robe covering his shoulders and upper chest. The background has a textured and patterned design with rays or lines emanating from his head. Text is written at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Holy Family with a Bird
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three figures: a woman, a man, and a child. The woman is seated, holding the child on her lap. She is turned to her right, looking at the man. The child is unclothed, except for a piece of drapery. The man is leaning forward, engaged with the woman. Behind them, a large tree trunk and branches are visible, with a background of clouds and sky.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the waist up, seated and slightly turned to the right. The person's face is turned to the left side of the frame and features expressive eyes, an aquiline nose, and full lips. The person has curly hair cascading around their face and neck. They are wearing flowing robes, and their left arm with a hand visible extends towards the viewer. The background includes light sketching of foliage.

artworks.title: Cascade in the Bois de Boulogne
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall cascading down from a rocky formation, surrounded by tall, leafless trees reaching towards the sky. The rocky structure is adorned with patches of climbing plants. The water flows into a small pool near us. The scene has a monochromatic color palette dominated by sepia tones. In the distance, thin branches of trees are visible against the sky.

artworks.title: Photographic album including a tintype of Amanda Berry Smith
artworks.medium: bound album of 30 albumen silver prints (cartes-de-visite) and 20 tintypes
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is an image of a deep red leather cover or case with an embossed design. The cover features a central oval shape surrounded by floral patterns and motifs. Additionally, there are four three-lobed shapes for symmetry. The leather shows signs of aging with wear and distress, including scuffs and discoloration. A brass corner piece with an engraved design is visible on the right.

artworks.title: The Ascension of Christ
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Faya Causey in memory of Philip Conisbee
artworks.description: The entire body of a bearded man is shown in this image, depicted in a floating position with arms outstretched and feet slightly apart. The man's facial features include a beard and long, wavy hair. His expression is serene, and his gaze is directed upwards. He is clothed in drapery that covers the lower half of his body, while his upper body is bare, showcasing a muscular torso. Surrounding him are various cherubic figures with wings arranged amid cloud-like formations. Above his head, a dove is depicted with outstretched wings. Below the man, a banner held by cherubic figures bears the inscription "EGO ET PATER VNVS SVMVS." The background consists of swirling clouds interspersed with more angelic figures.

artworks.title: A Winter's Walk
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Mark D. and Jeannie M. Golub Trust
artworks.description: The image shows a woman with curly hair wearing a hat and fur cape. She has a soft expression with gentle eyes and is holding a fur muff in her lap. The background features tree branches, and there is a border with an inscription from Keats at the bottom.

artworks.title: Christ in Glory with Angels and a Saint Kneeling in Adoration
artworks.medium: red chalk on light tan laid paper (artist’s correction for the figure of Christ, redrawn on an attached piece of laid paper)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jeffrey E. Horvitz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a central figure sitting amid clouds and surrounded by other figures. The artwork has a central male figure perched on a cloud and raising one hand. Around this figure are numerous other figures in dynamic poses, with some appearing to have wings. The figures are engaged in various actions, such as reaching out towards each other or in postures of adoration. The drawing is rendered in a warm, monochromatic palette, likely using sanguine chalk or a similar medium, giving it a classic appearance reminiscent of Renaissance or Baroque sketches. The swirling arrangement and light lines convey movement and upward motion, creating a sense of a divine or transcendent scene.

artworks.title: The Assumption of the Virgin with Two Bishops and Other Figures
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of black chalk on laid paper, laid down on a decorative mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jeffrey E. Horvitz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene. The description includes a central figure elevated in the air surrounded by clouds and angelic figures. Below this central motif is a large, ornately carved structure resembling an altar or pedestal, with figures in flowing robes on either side. The figures appear to be in a posture of reverence or awe, looking up towards the elevated figure. The drawing is executed in a delicate line work style with light shading.

artworks.title: Daughter of Jephthah
artworks.medium: pen and black ink  with brown wash, heightened with white gouache, on laid paper with a gold border, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jeffrey E. Horvitz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of armored figures, some on horseback, near a fortification. The image depicts figures interacting in front of a large stone structure that resembles a castle or fortified wall. On the left side, there are two figures on horseback clad in armor with helmets. One horse is in motion. On the right side, there are figures in flowing robes. One figure is holding an object aloft. The background shows additional details such as spears and a distant landscape with an additional structure. The use of light and shadow gives the drawing depth. The drawing shows intricate lines and shading that reveal the textures of the clothing and armor.

artworks.title: Jeremiah (Design for a Lunette)
artworks.medium: red chalk on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jeffrey E. Horvitz
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body sketch of a person seated with crossed legs. The figure's right arm is stretched out, and the left hand rests on the knee. The sketch shows a person with indistinguishable facial features but a visible beard. The hair is long, covered by a hood or draped cloth. The person wears flowing robes, without visible jewelry. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure's posture and attire.

artworks.title: King David (Design for a Lunette)
artworks.medium: red chalk on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jeffrey E. Horvitz
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a figure seated in a relaxed posture. The person has a beard, mustache, and short hair. A crown-like headpiece sits on their head. They are dressed in a flowing robe, with one hand on the arm of a chair or throne, and the other hand on the knee. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Agnès Entering a Grotto
artworks.medium: black chalk with touches of white chalk and charcoal(?) on laid paper, laid down on a decorative mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jeffrey E. Horvitz
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a leaning stance, with long hair and a flowing gown. She is barefoot and wearing a necklace with a cross pendant. She is positioned in a rocky, cave-like setting with soft lighting highlighting her figure.

artworks.title: Programme de théâtre (recto); Etudes (verso)
artworks.medium:
gouache, watercolor, brush and India ink, and graphite on paper (recto)
watercolor, pastel, brush and India ink, and graphite on paper (verso)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Jeff Atlas and Terry Atlas, in honor of Martin and Liane Atlas
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing side by side facing right. The man on the left is leaning forward on a cane. Both men are dressed in long coats, trousers, and shoes. The man on the left has a reddish complexion and dark hair, the other man wears a brown hat. The background depicts architectural shapes and lines with patches of blue and yellow. The scene is bordered by a black line on a plain paper background.

artworks.title: The Deposition
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as a Gift of Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving a hillside and architectural structures. The image shows a moment under a wooden scaffold with a ladder. Several figures surround a central figure who is reclining or lying down. The figures have somber and caring postures, appearing to offer support or comfort. Delicate and fluid lines compose the figures, illustrating flowing hair and draped clothing. The backdrop features a soft, distant rendering of an ancient city or fortress situated atop a hill. The foreground includes a framework, a basket, and scattered objects that suggest a scene of significance and preparation. The grayscale tones and line quality indicate a high level of craftsmanship and attention to detail in this illustration.

artworks.title: Jeunes bergers des environs de Chieti (Shepherd Children outside Chieti)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as a Gift of the Washington Print Club
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with dense foliage and trees, a receding path, distant livestock, detailed rendering of animals and children, and a monochromatic color palette. In the foreground, there are sheep and two children in rural attire, one leading the flock with a stick and the other holding their hand. Farther away, more sheep are visible with trees and brush in the background.

artworks.title: Saturn Presiding Over Agriculture
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The scene depicts various figures working on the land, with one using a scythe. A standing figure holds a drum. A large statue of a nude male figure holding a sickle and a child stands atop a pedestal in the distance. Rolling hills and a small dwelling with smoke rising can be seen on the horizon. The engraving showcases fine, precise lines in earthy grays and browns, creating a textured appearance. The background includes a depiction of Capricorn and a small figure with an urn in the sky.

artworks.title: Jupiter Presiding Over the Liberal Arts
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a statue and various figures engaged in scholarly activities. The drawing shows a large statue of a bearded figure holding lightning bolts on a pedestal. Surrounding the statue, figures are shown reading, writing, and studying a globe with a compass. The background displays architectural elements resembling Roman or Greek structures, including columns and arches. Above, there are mythical creatures, a fish, and a centaur-like figure among the clouds. The text at the bottom describes the scene as a representation of wisdom and divine guidance in education.

artworks.title: Mars Presiding Over the Arts of War
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of soldiers around a large statue of a warrior. The soldiers are gathered around the base of the statue, some playing drums and organizing their equipment. The statue depicts a muscular, helmeted warrior holding a spear. Other soldiers in the background hold spears and flags. Two symbols, an Aries and a Scorpio, are depicted hovering in the sky. The soldiers are dressed in historical battle attire, including plumed helmets. The drawing includes intricate shading and detailed line work that give the piece depth and convey a narrative of military readiness and valor.

artworks.title: Apollo Presiding Over the Arts of Government
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture at the center of the image depicts a nude male figure standing in a classical contrapposto pose. The figure is robust and muscular, holding a bow in his left hand and an arrow in his right hand. The sculpture is made of a light-colored material, likely marble or a similar stone, detailed to show the contours of his body. The figure stands atop a decorative base adorned with intricate designs and motifs. Surrounding the sculpture are various figures dressed in elaborate historical European garments. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Venus Presiding Over the Arts of Love
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring symbolic figures and interactions. The drawing shows two central figures embracing in the foreground, surrounded by draped clothing and flowing hair. In the background, a statue-like female figure stands with an arm around a young companion holding a staff or arrow. Behind them, groups of figures are engaging in various activities in a paradisiacal setting with trees, hills, and clouds. Above them are symbols and zodiac representations, such as scales and a bull. The image is filled with intricate patterns and classical elements.

artworks.title: Mercury Presiding Over the Visual and Rhetoric Arts
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a mythological scene involving Mercury, the Roman god, in a scholarly setting. Various characters are engaged in discussion, reading, and studying around a central statue of Mercury with a winged helmet. In the background, there are buildings and architectural elements, indicating an ancient city or town square. The composition shows figures engaged in activities associated with learning and intellect, such as holding a book or reading. The artwork combines ancient and Renaissance elements, and includes astrological symbols and celestial figures in the clouds, suggesting themes related to the transmission of knowledge and the arts under divine guidance.

artworks.title: Diana Presiding Over Navigation and Fishing
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a coastal scene with a statue and various marine activities. The scene features a large statue of a nude figure standing on a pedestal. Surrounding the statue, there are several figures engaged in activities related to the sea, such as handling nets and baskets with fish. In the background, there are ships and boats, suggesting a busy maritime area, possibly a port or a fishing village. The setting is lively, with birds flying and distant landscapes indicating a coastal community. The engraving style captures the human form, textures of the sea, and movement of ships on the horizon.
